system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Retrieves the current status and details of a PMFBY policy including policy_status ('not_enrolled', 'enrolled', 'active', 'expired'), crop, land parcel, premium paid, and coverage amount.. my policy_id is None.

function.name: pmfby_get_policy_status
function.description: Retrieves the current status and details of a PMFBY policy including policy_status ('not_enrolled', 'enrolled', 'active', 'expired'), crop, land parcel, premium paid, and coverage amount. Requires session_token. This tool does NOT modify the policy or process claims. Fails if policy_id is invalid or does not belong to the authenticated farmer.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

policy_id.description: Unique identifier of the insurance policy.
